full_sentence: Although the house is small, it has a big garden.

options.text: so it has a big garden.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, but 'although' requires a contrast between the two clauses.

options.text: it is very old and dark.
options.why_wrong: This describes the house again instead of giving a contrasting feature after 'although'.
'And' adds a parallel idea and cannot follow 'although'. The main clause must contrast with the first clause.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must show a contrast with the first clause. Portuguese speakers may be tempted to add a result connector here, but an English concessive clause needs a contrasting idea instead.
translation: Embora a casa seja pequena, ela tem um jardim grande.
